failureDescription: An external source page carries a use restriction relevant to the intended AI audition, while the downloaded archive and its embedded license metadata omit that restriction.
mustNeverRepeat: treating an offline license file as complete source-rights evidence without checking the current original listing
encoding a platform use restriction as an SPDX license term without evidence that it is part of the license
allowing AI audition when intended use intersects a captured NoAI restriction
claiming legal enforceability or legal clearance from a metadata gate
gateLogic: source license differs from concluded license without explanation -> HOLD_LICENSE_CONCLUSION_MISMATCH
source restriction omitted from offline metadata but unrelated to intended use -> HOLD_RIGHTS_METADATA_INCOMPLETE
source restriction intersects intended use -> REJECTED_RIGHTS_CONFLICT
adoptionBoundary: Candidate only; requires Mother acknowledgement and a real audition before any wider adoption.
